item.title: Katsina govt under scrutiny as bandits raid villages amid planned release of suspects
item.description: Bandits on Tuesday night carried out coordinated raids on several communities, east of the Federal University, Dutsin-Ma (FUDMA), in Dutsin-Ma Local Government Area of Katsina State, looting homes and rustling a large number of livestock. item.title: AFCON: Why Nigeria lost to Morocco – Super Eagles coach, Chelle

item.title: Don urges Nigerian government to develop animal feed from saw dust, rice chaff
item.description: The Federal government has been advised to develop more nutrition-rich animal feeds for the Nigerian livestock industry by refining municipal organic wastes such as saw dust, rice chaff and other untapped waste resources. A Professor of Animal Nutrition/Breeding Genetics, Nnamdi Anigbogu gave the advice on Wednesday while delivering the 67th Inaugural Lecture of Michael Okpara […] Don urges Nigerian government to develop animal feed from saw dust, rice chaff

item.title: NJC clears Osun CJ of all misconduct allegations
item.description: The National Judicial Council, NJC, has cleared the Chief Judge of Osun State, Justice Oyebola Adepele Ojo, of allegations bordering on financial recklessness, diversion of funds and judicial misconduct. The Council said it accepted in full the report of a three-member Investigation Committee constituted to examine several petitions submitted against the Osun State Chief Judge. […] NJC clears Osun CJ of all misconduct allegations

item.title: Two crushed to death as petrol tanker crashes into motorcycle in Lagos
item.description: A fatal road accident occurred on Wednesday in Lagos when an empty petrol tanker ran into a commercial motorcycle, killing both the rider and his passenger at Pokia Junction, inward Araga, along the Epe–Ijebu Road in Epe.
